notes.title: Scrolling Star Generator Update!
notes.content:
Space2D now includes a free tileable star field generator addon, allowing you to create seamlessly scrolling backgrounds and skyboxes! The Tileable Star Generator can be opened from a button on the main menu, or from an exe in the Space2D folder.

Other changes include a significant reduction in the amount of memory the program uses.

Enjoy! :gilma:

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
Hi!

I've updated Space2D to include an experimental lighting option for imported images. The checkbox to activate this can be found on the Import tab, it's still a work in progress but I wanted to get something functional as it was a requested feature.

Other minor fixes include more precise scrolling and zooming, along with bugfixes.

Thanks for the continued feedback!
